text.launch: Thanks for your patience on this one. We had the whole team together on Monday and Tuesday, went through the launch plan line by line, and I think we are in a much better place than two weeks ago. The new photos are in, the shop pages read well, the translations came back from the agency without surprises, and the support team has its answers ready for the first week. Everyone was pleased with how it looks on a phone too, and the loading times are down by half.
text.house: Hope you are both well and that the move went smoothly. We had a lovely weekend at the coast, the kids were in the water for two days straight, and only Sunday evening brought some rain. On the way back we stopped at the garden center you mentioned and found the terracotta pots, so thank you for the tip. I also ran into Noor there, who says hello and asked whether you are coming to the street party next month, since they are counting heads for the barbecue.
text.audit: I went through the folder you shared last week with Priya and we compared it with what the auditor listed in their first letter. The ledgers for the first three quarters are complete and the bank statements match to the cent. The asset register was updated after the sale of the van, and the payroll summaries carry the corrected dates. Priya also renamed the files so that the numbering follows the auditor's list, which should save everyone some searching later on.
text.quote: Good to speak on Thursday, and thank you for walking us through the workshop. We were impressed by the new press and by how you keep the offcuts sorted for reuse. After the visit I talked with our operations lead and with finance, who both had a look at the samples you gave us. The matte finish is the clear favorite, the rounded corners are a nice touch, and the weight of the paper feels right for what we have in mind. The sample box is now on everyone's desk.
